disposition_reason: This preprint is part two of a two-part study and reprints the same 40 Soroti beef samples already extracted from kasozi2021-uganda-beef-metals (same eight metals; Cu range 0.7-3.6 ppm matches). Marked context so the data count once.

study.design: Multivariate (PCA, cluster) and ILCR analysis of an existing beef dataset
study.method: 1 g wet tissue digested with HNO3/HClO4, made up to 50 mL; flame AAS (PerkinElmer 2380)
study.qa: Blank and laboratory control samples; no CRM or recoveries reported

unresolved: Per-sample values in Table 1 duplicate the dataset of Kasozi et al. 2021 (Frontiers in Nutrition, 10.3389/fnut.2021.592340), extracted under kasozi2021-uganda-beef-metals; not re-extracted.
The filed PDF is the Research Square preprint (posted 1 March 2021, DOI 10.21203/rs.3.rs-289141/v1), not the Toxicology Reports version of record (10.1016/j.toxrep.2023.03.004) named in the manifest.
source_record_corrections: Printed DOI is 10.21203/rs.3.rs-289141/v1 (Research Square preprint); manifest DOI 10.1016/j.toxrep.2023.03.004 is the later version of record, which was not filed.
